SepulcherNpc/31921.htm.text: Conquerors' Sepulcher Manager: A strange-looking stone statue.

SepulcherNpc/31921-FULL.htm.text: Conquerors' Sepulcher Manager: There is another party already in the sepulcher. Try again later.

SepulcherNpc/31921-NE.htm.text: Conquerors' Sepulcher Manager: Visiting hours are over!

SepulcherNpc/31921-NL.htm.text: Conquerors' Sepulcher Manager: The statue will only respond to the leader of the party.

SepulcherNpc/31921-NS.htm.text: Conquerors' Sepulcher Manager: One among your party hasn't fulfilled the request of the nameless soul. Ask %member% to go and meet with the nameless soul and do as he asks.

SepulcherNpc/31921-SE.htm.text: Conquerors' Sepulcher Manager: One of your party members doesn't have a pass. Either give %member% a pass to enter the sepulcher, or ask him to go get one and come back.

SepulcherNpc/31921-SP.htm.text: Conquerors' Sepulcher Manager: Your party must consist of at least four members. Come back when you have more friends.

Q00620_FourGoblets/31921-01.html.text: Conquerors' Sepulcher Manager: Hark! Who goes there?

links.text: Touch the stone statue and concentrate...

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
